title: Pure Laval
match: Soaring Eagle Above the Searing Land
summary: Laval cards only, with generic Links and staples. Laval is a FIRE Synchro deck that fills its GY with different Laval names and turns on effects that need three or more of them. The 2021 cards lead. Laval Archer grants an extra Laval Normal Summon and revives itself by destroying your FIRE monster. Lavalval Salamander draws two when Synchro Summoned and flips their monsters face-down. Lavalval Exlord destroys a monster that activates an effect, and revives up to three FIRE monsters when destroyed. Laval Volcano Handmaiden mills another Laval when it goes to the GY, and Molten Conduction Field mills two. Laval Coatl summons itself once three Laval names are in the GY, and Lavalval Dragun searches a Laval each turn.
